plugins.name: eodhd-api
plugins.description: Developer-first financial data for Claude — 150k+ tickers, 70+ exchanges, real-time & historical prices, fundamentals, options, technicals, news, sentiment, macro indicators, ESG, and more via EODHD API and MCP Server.

skills.name: company-brief
skills.description: Generate a comprehensive company snapshot using EODHD data — profile, fundamentals, recent news, sentiment, insider transactions, and key metrics. Use when the user asks about a specific company, wants a stock overview, or needs a quick investment brief.
skills.description_zh: 使用EODHD生成公司概览，汇总资料、基本面、新闻、情感、内部人交易与关键指标，支持股票速览和投资简报。

skills.name: earnings-monitor
skills.description: Monitor upcoming and recent earnings — calendar, trends, news context, and options activity around earnings dates. Use when the user asks about earnings season, upcoming reports, earnings surprises, or pre/post-earnings analysis.
skills.description_zh: 监测即将公布或近期盈利报告，结合日历、趋势、新闻和日期附近期权活动，分析业绩意外及前后变化。

skills.name: eodhd-analyze
skills.description: Comprehensive single-company analysis using EODHD data — profile, fundamentals, price action, news sentiment, insider activity, and technicals, presented as a structured company brief. Invoke as /eodhd-analyze <ticker>.
skills.description_zh: 使用EODHD对单家公司综合分析资料、基本面、价格、新闻情感、内部人活动与技术指标，形成结构化简报。

skills.name: eodhd-api
skills.description: Fetch financial data from EODHD API — historical prices, fundamentals, options, technical indicators, news, sentiment, macro indicators, corporate events, ESG scores, risk analytics, bank data, US Treasury rates, and trading hours. Use when the user asks for stock prices, company fundamentals, financial analysis, market data, earnings, dividends, splits, IPOs, insider transactions, screener, or building financial tools with EODHD data.
skills.description_zh: 通过EODHD API获取历史价格、基本面、期权、技术指标、新闻、宏观、公司事件、ESG、风险、银行、国债和交易时间，用于财务分析与工具开发。

skills.name: eodhd-compare
skills.description: Side-by-side comparison of two or more companies using EODHD data — valuation, financials, profitability, performance, and dividends in comparison tables. Invoke as /eodhd-compare <ticker1> <ticker2> ...
skills.description_zh: 使用EODHD并排比较多家企业估值、财务、盈利、表现与股息，生成对照表。

skills.name: eodhd-macro
skills.description: Macro-economic dashboard using EODHD data — GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rates, Treasury yield curve, real yields, and the economic events calendar. Invoke as /eodhd-macro [country or region].
skills.description_zh: 使用EODHD生成指定国家或地区宏观仪表板，汇总GDP、CPI、失业、利率、国债曲线、实际收益及事件。

skills.name: eodhd-market
skills.description: Comprehensive market overview using EODHD data — major indices, sector performance, Treasury yield curve, macro snapshot, and commodities. Invoke as /eodhd-market [region].
skills.description_zh: 通过EODHD汇总地区主要指数、板块、国债曲线、宏观与商品，形成市场概览。

skills.name: eodhd-screen
skills.description: Screen stocks by fundamental and technical criteria using the EODHD screener — market cap, P/E, dividend yield, sector, exchange, and signals, with currency- aware thresholds. Invoke as /eodhd-screen <criteria>.
skills.description_zh: 按市值、估值、股息、板块、交易所和技术信号筛选EODHD股票，并考虑币种阈值。

skills.name: macro-dashboard
skills.description: Macro-economic dashboard — GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rates, Treasury yields, trade balance, and economic events calendar. Use when the user asks about the economy, macro trends, interest rates, or economic indicators.
skills.description_zh: 生成GDP、CPI、失业、利率、国债、贸易余额和事件的宏观仪表板。

skills.name: market-overview
skills.description: Generate a broad market overview — major indices, sector performance, top movers, macro indicators, Treasury rates, and commodities. Use when the user asks "how's the market?", wants a daily market summary, or needs a macro context for investment decisions.
skills.description_zh: 生成大盘、板块、涨跌、宏观、国债和商品的市场概览，为每日摘要或投资背景提供资料。

skills.name: options-analyzer
skills.description: Analyze options chains, implied volatility, Greeks, and strategy payoffs using EODHD Marketplace options data. Use when the user asks about options, implied volatility, Greeks, or options strategies.
skills.description_zh: 依据EODHD Marketplace期权数据分析链、隐含波动、希腊值与策略收益。

skills.name: portfolio-risk
skills.description: Analyze portfolio risk — technical indicators, sentiment shifts, insider alerts, ESG scores, and volatility metrics. Use when the user asks about portfolio risk, wants to assess holdings, or needs risk/reward analysis.
skills.description_zh: 结合技术指标、情感、内部人提醒、ESG和波动评估投资组合风险及持仓风险回报。

skills.name: stock-screener
skills.description: Screen stocks by fundamental and technical criteria using EODHD screener — filter by market cap, P/E, dividend yield, sector, signals, and more. Use when the user wants to find stocks matching specific criteria.
headings: High-dividend large caps (dividend_yield is a fraction: 0.03 = 3%; nyse avoids OTC junk; <=0.25 caps broken yields)
then drop rows whose code contains '-' (preferred shares)
skills.description_zh: 使用EODHD按市值、估值、股息、板块与信号等基本面技术条件筛选股票。
